# cg6kwin2k.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

Sangoma cg6kwin2k versions before 2.1.7.0 expose IOCTLs without sufficient access control. A low-privilege user can perform I/O against arbitrary hardware ports or physical addresses, enabling firmware erasure or modification.
- **UUID**: fda3ff67-12dc-488c-a4c2-603f5bf420bd
- **Created**: 2023-11-02
- **Author**: Takahiro Haruyama
- **Acknowledgement**: fluffycats31 | [@fluffycats31](https://twitter.com/@fluffycats31)

This download link contains the vulnerable driver!

{{< /tip >}}

{{< blockbanner "cg6kwin2k.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create cg6kwin2ksys binPath= C:\windows\temp\cg6kwin2ksys.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start cg6kwin2ksys
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | kernel | Windows 10 |
